# Code of Conduct

## Purpose

This project aims to be a respectful, useful place to collaborate on hardware design work.
I maintain this repository as a solo project today, but contributions and discussion are welcome.

## Expected Behavior

Please:

* Be respectful and constructive in issues, pull requests, and discussions
* Assume good intent and ask clarifying questions before escalating
* Keep feedback focused on design, implementation, and documented requirements
* Accept that not every suggestion can or will be merged

## Unacceptable Behavior

The following is not acceptable:

* Harassment, hate speech, threats, or personal attacks
* Discrimination based on personal characteristics
* Trolling, intentionally inflammatory comments, or repeated bad-faith arguments
* Publishing private information without explicit permission
* Spam, scams, or unrelated promotional content

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all project spaces, including issues, pull requests, reviews, and discussions.

## Maintainer Responsibilities

As maintainer, I may remove comments, close discussions, or reject contributions that violate this Code of Conduct or are otherwise harmful to the project.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, report it privately by opening a discussion marked as private if available, or by contacting me directly through GitHub.

I will review reports in good faith and take action I consider appropriate for project safety and health.
